# John Meredith

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v5 c7 P34](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0034), [v5 c21 P0](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Minister  <sub>[v5 c2 P40](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0040), [v5 c7 P32](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0032), [v5 c21 P4](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0004)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Jack  <sub>[v5 c13 P2](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

He has dark, dreamy eyes and slender white hands with a surprisingly strong grip. In his youth, he was known as Jack.

_Sources: [v5 c13 P2](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0002), [v5 c13 P4](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0004), [v5 c21 P11](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0011)_

## Personality

Mr. Meredith is a deeply scholarly, spiritual, and refined man, though notably shy, aloof, and absent-minded. Beneath his quiet exterior, he possesses the heart of a boy and retains strong ideals that prevent him from acting cold-bloodedly or marrying merely for convenience. He loves his children dearly, though his frequent lost-in-thought moments leave him oblivious to practical domestic details.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P40](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0040), [v5 c13 P2](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0002), [v5 c14 P37](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0037), [v5 c21 P2](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0002), [v5 c21 P3](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0003)_

## History

John Meredith served as the Presbyterian minister at Glen St. Mary, living at the manse with his four young children—Jerry, Faith, Una, and Carl—and his elderly relative, Aunt Martha. Known for his powerful preaching but intense absent-mindedness, he often forgot meetings or practical matters, sparking community gossip and concern over his children's upbringing. Following a confrontation with Mrs. Alec Davis, who offered to take Una, he grappled with his shortcomings as a father and sought comfort in the friendship of Rosemary West. He met Rosemary in Rainbow Valley by a hidden spring and grew deeply attached to her, eventually deciding to ask her to marry him.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P40](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0040), [v5 c13 P5](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0005), [v5 c13 P6](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0006), [v5 c14 P37](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0037), [v5 c14 P39](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0039), [v5 c21 P0](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0000), [v5 c21 P1](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0001), [v5 c21 P4](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0004)_
